title: IaC & First Steps
summary: Why infrastructure as code exists, how Terraform is built (core, providers, registry), HCL basics, the init/plan/apply/destroy workflow and how to read a plan. Labs run locally with the Docker and local providers.
objectives: Explain declarative vs imperative infrastructure and where Terraform fits next to Pulumi, CloudFormation, CDK, Ansible and OpenTofu
Describe Terraform's architecture: core, providers as plugins over gRPC, the registry and the dependency lock file
Write a `terraform` block with `required_version`, `required_providers` and sensible version constraints
Run the core workflow (`init`, `fmt`, `validate`, `plan`, `apply`, `destroy`) and know what each step does
Read a plan and tell create, destroy, in-place update and replacement apart
Use resource addresses and inspect the implicit dependency graph with `terraform graph`
